limitationOfLiability.standard: Liability capped at fees paid in prior 12 months.
limitationOfLiability.fallback: Cap at 24 months fees with privacy and security carveouts.
limitationOfLiability.escalateWhen: Uncapped liability or consequential damages are included.

dataProcessing.standard: Approved DPA and security exhibit required before PHI processing.
dataProcessing.fallback: Customer DPA accepted after privacy and security review.
dataProcessing.escalateWhen: PHI is referenced without approved DPA/BAA/security exhibit.

slaCredits.standard: Service credits capped at monthly fees.
slaCredits.fallback: Higher capped credits with service owner approval.
slaCredits.escalateWhen: Uncapped SLA credits or refund rights appear.
